narr: Deep monsoon moisture remained over northern Arizona with strong thunderstorms across the area. An area of low pressure moving over the area from the east help form thunderstorm complexes that brought widespread moderate to heavy rain to northern Arizona.
ev: A vehicle was caught in the flood waters of Dinnebito Wash near Route 6720 and Saltwater Wash. There was one fatality and two others trapped in the water. This was located about 72 air miles downstream from the headwaters of this wash.
Heavy rain dislodged rocks that fell on Highway 89 between Flagstaff and Sedona (switchbacks near FR-237).
Heavy rain caused the Verde River to rise 2 feet (near the junction of the Verde River and Sycamore Creek).

A vehicle was caught in the flood waters of Dinnebito Wash near Route 6720 and Saltwater Wash. There was one fatality and two others trapped in the water. This was located about 72 air miles downstream from the headwaters of this wash.
Local Law Enforcement reported that Polacca Wash was overtopping State Route 264 just east of First Mesa.
Major flash flooding was reported on a widely used dirt road between Whippoorwill and Low Mountain.
Big Hollow Wash almost overtopped the bridge at Highway 61 west St Johns.
The Agua Fria River came up 7.2 feet at the gauge on Tara Springs Road near Black Canyon City. The flood waters came from as far away as Dewey (20 straight miles).
Kirkland Creek was flowing 4.5 feet deep (estimated) and was flowing over Highway 89. Water had begun to recede by 0630 AM.
lsr: PUBLIC REPORTS FLASH FLOOD. RIVER VALLEY ROAD AND HEROLD RANCH ROADS IMPASSABLE FOR TRAVEL DUE TO WATER ON ROAD.
AGUA FRIA GAUGE NEAR MAYER REPORTS 5.7 FT RISE.
GAUGE AT TARA SPRINGS ROAD NEAR BLACK CANYON CITY (YABA3) CAME UP 7.2 FEET.
LAW ENFORCEMENT REPORTED AND ESTIMATED DEPTH OF KIRKLAND CREEK RUNNING 4-5 FT DEEP WITH WATER FLOWING OVER HIGHWAY 89. WATER HAD BEGUN TO RECEDE AT TIME OF OBSERVATION.
MAJOR FLOODING ON WIDELY USED DIRT ROAD BETWEEN WHIPPOORWILL AND LOW MOUNTAIN. PHOTO POSTED ON OUR FB.
ADOT REPORTS ROCKS IN ROADWAY ON SR-89 SOUTHBOUND NEAR NF-237.
GAUGE AT VERDE RIVER AND SYCAMORE CREEK (VDCA3) ROSE 2.0 FT.
*** 1 FATAL *** VEHICLE TRAPPED IN DINNEBITO WASH. WATER RESCUE ONGOING. 1 KNOWN FATALITY, 2 OTHERS TRAPPED IN THE WATER PER COCONINO COUNTY SHERIFF.
